## Innio Flagged as Potentially Undervalued on Data Center Power Order Despite Mixed Q2

Data center power generation is an increasingly constrained bottleneck in the AI buildout; an order win in this space — even for a smaller name — signals emerging demand for non-hyperscaler power infrastructure, a thematic signal worth tracking even if INIO is not a core holding.

- INIO is flagged as potentially trading below fair value by two outlets covering the story.
- A data center power generation order win is cited as the key positive catalyst underlying the undervaluation argument.
- Q2 results were mixed, creating the valuation ambiguity rather than a clean positive setup.
- Coverage is split on whether the order win justifies a meaningful re-rating.
